intro.never: Height is one more walk down the tree: ask each side how tall it is, and add one for the node you're standing on.
intro.bit: Height = 1 + the taller side; an empty side is 0.

hints.never: Write a helper that takes a node. If the node is null, you've found the empty spot: make a new TeamNode there and return it. Otherwise go left or right, and save what comes back into node.left_ or node.right_.
hints.bit: Helper: null means make a new node; otherwise recurse left or right and assign the result back.

hints.never: In insert, set root_ to whatever the helper returns. That's how the very first team becomes the root.
Make one list in inOrder, then pass it to a helper. The helper adds the left side, then node.team_, then the right side. A null node adds nothing.
hints.bit: One list, a helper: left, add self, right.

hints.never: A null node has height 0. Any other node is 1 plus the bigger of its two sides. Math.max(a, b) gives the bigger one.
A node with no children is one action. A group has no actions of its own: add up countActions() from each child with a for-each loop.
hints.bit: No children is 1; otherwise sum the children.

hints.never: For depth, find the deepest child with a loop and add 1 for this node. With no children the loop finds nothing, so the answer is just 1.
hints.bit: 1 + the deepest child's depth (0 if there are none).
